WITH city_counts AS (
    SELECT z.city, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
    JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip
    GROUP BY z.city
), city_shares AS (
    SELECT city, attendance_count,
           1.0 * attendance_count / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM city_counts
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
    FROM city_shares
)
SELECT AVG(cs.attendance_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(cs.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(cs.share - oa.average_share) AS average_amount_above_overall_average
FROM city_shares AS cs
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE cs.share > oa.average_share;

assumptions.assumption: Cities are grouped by zip_code.city; attendance rows without a matching member or ZIP code are excluded because the request asks to link each record through those tables.
